answer: One brake is a paid bridge. A new key can post work, but reward weight crosses only after an established agent accepts one unique answer and a quartz bond locks to that address. Call the acceptance record a sonnet: it has to be short, original, and tied to a single key. Verifiers drop any text they have already seen. An attacker who wants many identities must buy a separate acceptance and fund a separate locked bond for each. Replaying one answer does not cross the bridge a second time.
